roadmap.goal: Slice 02: pick a Visual Task Board and have Lighthouse fill in the query and the kind of work from it, both still editable. A ServiceNow shop's team boundary already exists as a board — table plus filter — and today Lighthouse makes you re-author it as an encoded query you have to go find first. This is the half of #5610 the story was actually filed for.
roadmap.overview: Four steps, inside-out. 02-01 builds the two pure cores and the connector's two read methods, so every decision about what a board means is settled in a testable core before anything is wired. 02-02 opens the driving port — one WizardsController switch arm plus a catch that turns a refusal into a 400 carrying its verdict. 02-03 does the frontend: one registry row, the empty-fallback deletion that has been waiting since D9, and the RBAC gate that stops three connectors' buttons lying. 02-04 runs the four Earned Trust assertions against the live PDI, because 164 tests did not find what one manual run did.
roadmap.red_by_skip: Project convention. DISTILL authored every scenario and marked it [Ignore] / .skip so main compiles and stays green; each step un-skips only its own and implements to GREEN. 17 backend and 5 frontend scaffolds are outstanding at the start of this slice.

validation.notes: Authored by the orchestrator from the DESIGN component decomposition, driving-ports and driven-ports tables, which already name every component, its contract shape and its purity class. Slice 01 is DONE and committed (01-01..01-04). ADR-127 / story #5627 is NOT in this roadmap: no advisory channel, no TeamService verdict change, no ValidationAdvisory mounting.

siblings_to_mirror.closest_provider: LinearWorkTrackingConnector.GetBoards / GetBoardInformation (~:817-880) — list entities as boards, then read one entity's detail into BoardInformation

measured_facts_do_not_contradict.boards_are_shared_not_roled: vtb_board's read ACL carries NO role and runs VTBBoardSecurity().canAccess(current). itil/snc_read/no-roles all read 200 with ZERO rows; adding lh_probe_itil to vtb_board_member produced the board, its 38 cards and its 6 lanes, and deleting the row reverted it. The list is scoped to the CONNECTION'S service account.
measured_facts_do_not_contradict.filter_vs_readable_filter: filter is the verbatim encoded query in COLUMN form (correlation_id=LIGHTHOUSE_DEMO, 38 of 105 incidents). readable_filter is the LABEL form and selects the WHOLE TABLE (105/105 and 118/118). readable_filter is never read, never carried, never displayed — ServiceNowBoardMapper must not know it exists.
measured_facts_do_not_contradict.cards_are_not_membership: A filtered board's vtb_card set is a snapshot behind its filter (change_request: 7 cards, 13 matches). Copy the filter, never the cards.
measured_facts_do_not_contradict.x_total_count_is_acl_blind: Every 0-row board read returned X-Total-Count: 2. Count boards from the BODY, never the header.
measured_facts_do_not_contradict.no_board_type_column: sys_class_name is empty on every vtb_board row; there is no type field. Emptiness of table/filter is the only discriminator — which is what D14's scoping keys on.
measured_facts_do_not_contradict.non_task_board: A cmdb_ci board is creatable and yields 0 from a task-rooted read. Refuse it by name.

Any change to slice 01's placeholder or help text

phases.name: Pick a Visual Task Board to pre-fill query + kind of work
phases.description: Two pure cores and two connector reads, then the driving port, then the frontend, then the live-instance proof.

steps.name: The two pure cores and the connector's two board reads
criteria: ServiceNowBoardMapper (pure) maps one vtb_board row to Board and to BoardInformation via the existing ServiceNowWorkItemMapper.ReadForm; DataRetrievalValue <- filter, WorkItemTypes <- [table]. It does NOT know readable_filter exists

ServiceNowBoardVerdict (pure) decides board-list and board-read outcomes, calling ServiceNowValidationVerdict.FromResponse through for every rung EXCEPT the one it must not inherit: an empty list is a 200 with a message, not a no_records_visible failure (DD-7)
WorkTrackingReadException is abstract and carries a ConnectionValidationResult; ServiceNowReadException derives from it, so a controller can catch a refusal without naming a ServiceNow type
GetBoards reads vtb_board scoped active=true^tableISNOTEMPTY^filterISNOTEMPTY (D14/DD-3), counts from the BODY never X-Total-Count, and reuses ReadEveryPage unchanged

GetBoardInformation re-applies the same scoping on its single-board read rather than trusting the list, and validates the board's table through the shipped ADR-124 ladder (WhyThisKindOfWorkCannotBeRead) so a cmdb_ci board is refused as class_is_not_a_kind_of_work (DD-4)
The purity ArchUnit fixture is widened to both new cores and passes
Every scenario in ServiceNowBoardPickerTest is un-skipped and GREEN; dotnet build zero warnings; dotnet test green
steps.scenario_name: An administrator opening the picker sees the boards this connection can turn into a team
steps.implementation_notes: The three inert scaffolds DISTILL landed (the interface's IBoardInformationProvider base, and the two connector methods returning empty) become real here. The board-read scaffold is currently unreachable because WizardsController has no ServiceNow arm — that stays true until 02-02, so this step can be verified in isolation. Mirror LinearWorkTrackingConnector.GetBoards for shape. Do NOT re-derive the four-shape row parsing: ReadForm exists for exactly this. Do NOT add sysparm_fields to the board read (ADR-114: projection was never measured against ACL row filtering). The empty-list rung is the ONE place ServiceNowBoardVerdict must diverge from the connection ladder — everything else calls through.

steps.name: The driving port answers, and a refusal keeps its name
criteria: WizardsController.GetBoardInformationProviderForWorkTrackingSystem gains its WorkTrackingSystems.ServiceNow arm; ServiceNow no longer falls through to NotImplementedException
A refusal thrown as WorkTrackingReadException becomes BadRequest(ConnectionValidationResult) — the controller catches the abstract type and never names a ServiceNow class
GET /wizards/{connId}/boards answers 200 + [] for an empty list, and 400 + verdict for every refusal rung
A 403 on the board table says the account cannot read it, naming the table, rather than 'Failed to load boards. Please try again.' (AC-B3)
The RbacGuard stays SystemAdmin (ADR-126 D4) — do not widen it
Both acceptance scenarios in ServiceNowConnectionAcceptanceTest are un-skipped and GREEN
steps.scenario_name: An administrator asking a ServiceNow connection for its boards is told why rather than shown a fault
steps.implementation_notes: WizardsController is ~60 lines; the change is one switch arm and one catch. These scenarios observe today's behaviour as a 500 (the NotImplementedException), so RED here is the difference between a fault and an answer.

steps.name: The picker appears, refuses legibly, and stops the button lying
criteria: One DataRetrievalWizardRegistry row: servicenow.board, applicableSettingsContexts ['team'], component BoardWizard. Portfolio context does not offer it

BoardWizard's empty-fallback is DELETED (D9): a failed board read renders the reason and CANNOT be confirmed. It no longer substitutes an all-empty IBoardInformation that is truthy and enables Confirm. Note the corrected severity — that payload writes NOTHING today because handleWizardComplete guards every assignment on non-emptiness, so the defect is a silent no-op, a refusal wearing a success costume, not data loss

An empty board list gets its own copy naming BOTH causes and asserting neither: this account is a member of no board, and none of its boards carries both a table and a filter. X-Total-Count cannot tell them apart

Wizard buttons are gated on useRbac().isSystemAdmin (DD-8). This changes Jira, ADO and Linear too — today a CanCreateTeam user clicks 'Select Jira Board' and gets a 403 rendered as 'Failed to load boards. Please try again.'
The pre-filled query and Work Item Types remain editable; inputKind stays freetext and the field never becomes read-only (D8/AC-B2)
All 5 remaining frontend scaffolds un-skipped and GREEN; pnpm test green; pnpm build zero warnings; Biome clean
steps.scenario_name: shows the reason the board list was refused
steps.implementation_notes: DataRetrievalWizardRegistry.test.ts asserts toHaveLength(4) and becomes 5 — flagged by DISTILL as a known pre-requisite, so expect it rather than treat it as a surprise. The stale comment at DataRetrievalSchemaDefaults.ts:64 ('No wizard: SPIKE Q8 measured table/field discovery unavailable below itil') asserts ServiceNow has no wizard and must be amended here; the matching claim in IServiceNowWorkTrackingConnector.cs was already corrected in 02-01. Do NOT change inputKind, and do NOT set wizardHint — it is read by nothing (D5).

steps.name: Prove it against the instance, not only the fixtures
criteria: The four Earned Trust assertions in ServiceNowWorkTrackingConnectorIntegrationTest are un-skipped and pass against the live PDI: the board's filter selects a proper SUBSET of its table; the readable form selects the WHOLE table; an account sharing no board gets an empty success whose header count still names every board; a picked board pre-fills the work its own filter selects
AC-B6 as amended: the synced set equals the board's FILTER run against the board's TABLE — never the board's card set, which drifts behind its own filter
dotnet test green with the live tests enabled
steps.scenario_name: A board picked on the instance pre-fills the work its own filter selects
steps.implementation_notes: Needs $ServiceNowLighthouseIntegrationTestToken and PDI dev191338, and the boards are shared with admin only — an account that is not a vtb_board_member reads zero rows, so these must run as admin unless a vtb_board_member row is created. This is the step that catches what fixtures cannot: the epic's standing rule is that 164 tests did not find what one manual run did. If the PDI has been reclaimed (they go after ~10 days idle), say so and stop rather than quietly re-skipping.
